status: corrected and refrozen after version 1.0.0 stopped during header-only validation because 000102000 has the official OBJECT value Abell2319_Cor1 rather than Abell2319; no sky-event row or energy was read, selected, recalculated, summarized, or fit
purpose: Apply the held-out-validated common/differential interpolation only to the three A2319 science fragments genuinely bracketed by undisturbed Fe-55 fiducials, while excluding every one-sided or ADR-crossing fragment.

model.common_mode: exact linear interpolation of valid native calibration-pixel TEMP_FIT rows in the target observation
model.differential_mode: one time-linear D_i=T_i^FW-C_12 fit per main-array pixel using both complete adjacent Fe-55 anchor segments

excluded_branches.name: 000102_open_1_cross_obsid
excluded_branches.reason: although the original topology paired segments 2 and 3, the science fragment lies before the ADR and segment 3 lies after it, so this is not an undisturbed bracket

excluded_branches.name: 000103_post_adr_backward
excluded_branches.reason: one-sided backward extrapolation after the ADR

inputs.event_selection: exact frozen branch TIME interval AND PIXEL != 12

recorded_failures.failed_at: header-only validation of 000102000 cleaned OPEN event product
recorded_failures.root_cause: the frozen common OBJECT value assumed both pointings used Abell2319, while the archive correctly labels 000102000 as Abell2319_Cor1
recorded_failures.correction: freeze the exact hash-verified OBJECT value separately for each ObsID while retaining the common FILTER=OPEN and DETNAM=PIXEL checks

terminal_gate.pass_rule: Authorize freezing a three-fragment A2319 spectral-region protocol only if every application audit passes.

claim_boundary: This stage proves only that the held-out-validated bracketed calibration is executable and complete on the declared development sky rows.
No cluster energy distribution, line centroid, velocity, Sigma source term, lensing target, or gravity score may be inspected.
The excluded branches remain unresolved and cannot be silently restored downstream.
